```yaml
name: Database Export Artifacts

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  export-database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: '18'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Setup database export
      run: |
        mkdir -p ./exports
        echo "Setting up database export process"

    - name: Export sanitized SQLite database
      run: |
        # Create a sanitized copy of the database
        cp ./database/bookhive.db ./exports/bookhive-sanitized.db
        # Perform any sanitization operations here
        echo "Database exported and sanitized"

    - name: Compress database for artifact
      run: |
        cd ./exports
        zip -r bookhive-export.zip bookhive-sanitized.db
        echo "Database compressed for artifact upload"

    - name: Upload database artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: bookhive-database-export
        path: ./exports/bookhive-export.zip
        retention-days: 30

    - name: Create release with database artifact
      uses: facebook/dotslash-publish-release@v2
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      with:
        config: .github/release-config.yml
        tag: database-export-${{ github.run_number }}
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
